an5.180:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ
an5.180:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ
an5.180:1.3: disvāna maggā okkamma yena taṃ sālavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sālavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi.
an5.180:2.2: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya
an5.180:2.5: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya
an5.180:3.1: bhūtapubbaṃ ānanda imasmiṃ padese nagaraṃ ahosi iddhañceva phītañca bahujanaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ
an5.180:3.2: taṃ kho panānanda nagaraṃ kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya viharati
an5.180:3.3: kassapassa kho panānanda bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhavesī nāma upāsako ahosi sīlesu aparipūrakārī
an5.180:3.4: bhavesinā kho ānanda upāsakena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭidesitāni samādapitāni ahesuṃ sīlesu aparipūrakārino
an5.180:3.6: ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā ahañcamhi sīlesu aparipūrakārī imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu aparipūrakārino
an5.180:4.1: athakho ānanda bhavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etadavoca
an5.180:4.2: ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto sīlesu paripūrakāriṃ dhārethāti.
an5.180:4.3: athakho ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi
an5.180:4.4: ayyo kho bhavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:4.5: ayyo hi nāma bhavesī sīlesu paripūrakārī bhavissati
an5.180:4.7: athakho ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena bhavesī upāsako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhavesī upāsakaṃ etadavocuṃ
an5.180:4.8: ajjatagge ayyo bhavesī imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino dhāretūti.
an5.180:4.10: ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā ahañcamhi sīlesu paripūrakārī imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino
an5.180:5.1: athakho ānanda bhavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etadavoca
an5.180:5.2: ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto brahmacāriṃ dhāretha ārācāriṃ virataṃ methunā gāmadhammāti.
an5.180:5.3: athakho ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi
an5.180:5.4: ayyo kho bhavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:5.5: ayyo hi nāma bhavesī brahmacārī bhavissati ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā
an5.180:5.7: athakho ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena bhavesī upāsako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhavesī upāsakaṃ etadavocuṃ
an5.180:5.8: ajjatagge ayyo bhavesī imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino dhāretu ārācārino virate methunā gāmadhammāti.
an5.180:5.10: ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:5.13: ahañcamhi brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā
an5.180:5.14: imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā
an5.180:6.1: athakho ānanda bhavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etadavoca
an5.180:6.2: ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto ekabhattikaṃ dhāretha rattuparataṃ virataṃ vikālabhojanāti.
an5.180:6.3: athakho ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi
an5.180:6.4: ayyo kho bhavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:6.5: ayyo hi nāma bhavesī ekabhattiko bhavissati rattuparato virato vikālabhojanā
an5.180:6.7: athakho ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena bhavesī upāsako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhavesi upāsakaṃ etadavocuṃ
an5.180:6.8: ajjatagge ayyo bhavesī imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni ekabhattike dhāretu rattuparate virate vikālabhojanāti.
an5.180:6.10: ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:6.13: ahañcamhi brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā
an5.180:6.14: imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā
an5.180:6.16: imānipi pañca upāsakasatāni ekabhattikā rattuparatā viratā vikālabhojanā
an5.180:7.1: athakho ānanda bhavesī upāsako yena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca
an5.180:7.2: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
an5.180:7.3: alattha kho ānanda bhavesī upāsako kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ
an5.180:7.4: acirūpasampanno kho panānanda bhavesī bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an5.180:7.5: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an5.180:7.6: aññataro ca panānanda bhavesī bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosi.
an5.180:8.1: athakho ānanda tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi
an5.180:8.2: ayyo kho bhavesī amhākaṃ bahūpakāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā
an5.180:8.3: ayyo hi nāma bhavesī kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati
an5.180:8.5: athakho ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavocuṃ
an5.180:8.6: labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyāma upasampadanti
an5.180:8.7: alabhiṃsu kho ānanda tāni pañca upāsakasatāni kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ alabhiṃsu upasampadaṃ
an5.180:9.2: ahaṃ kho imassa anuttarassa vimuttisukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an5.180:9.3: ahovatimānipi pañca bhikkhusatāni imassa anuttarassa vimuttisukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhinoti
an5.180:9.4: athakho ānanda tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni ekekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ
an5.180:9.5: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihariṃsu
an5.180:9.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññiṃsu
an5.180:10.1: iti kho ānanda tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni bhavesi pamukhāni uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ vāyamamānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchākaṃsu.
an5.180:10.3: uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ vāyamamānā anuttaraṃ vimuttiṃ sacchikarissāmāti
